All other Three.js core classes (like `Group`, `Mesh`, `PlaneGeometry`, `Color`, `DirectionalLight`, etc.) *must* be destructured from `ctx.THREE`.
    *   **Export:** A single, synchronous default function: `createNode(config: NodeConfig, ctx: NodeContext): THREE.Object3D`. No async operations at the top level of the creation function.
    *   **Primitives:** The specification is clear: "Apply EVERY primitive listed in `config.cinematicPrimitives` by calling `ctx.primitives[primitive.name](targetObject, primitive.params)`. import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { mix, uv, vec3 } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color, DirectionalLight, SpotLight } = ctx.THREE;

  const container = new Group();

  // Color Palette
  const palette = {
    ink: new Color('#16161d'),
    paper: new Color('#e8ecf2'),
    accent: new Color('#ff2a38'),
    surface: new Color('#0b0b10')
  };

  // Keep track of active timelines to dispose during cleanup
  const activeTimelines = [];
  const trackTimeline = (tl) => {
    activeTimelines.push(tl);
    return tl;
  };

  // 1. Stage Backdrop: 7x6 plane at z = -2.5
  // Uses a beautiful, engineered gradient from ink to surface to avoid FLAT_VOID
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
  const backdropMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    roughness: 0.85,
    metalness: 0.1
  });
  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(
    vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063), // #0b0b10 (surface)
    vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114), // #16161d (ink)
    uv().y
  );
  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.z = -2.5;
  container.add(backdropMesh);

  // 2. Interactive Card Group (All hover & tilt animations interact here)
  const cardGroup = new Group();
  container.add(cardGroup);

  // Dimensions (512x320 Aspect Ratio ~ 1.6 ratio)
  const width = 2.4;
  const height = 1.5;
  const borderThickness = 0.05;

  // 3. Contact Shadow (Fades with hover state)
  const shadowGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width * 1.15, 0.25);
  const shadowMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: 0x000000,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.45,
    roughness: 1.0
  });
  const shadowMesh = new Mesh(shadowGeo, shadowMat);
  shadowMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2.3;
  shadowMesh.position.set(0, -height / 2 - 0.15, -0.1);
  cardGroup.add(shadowMesh);

  // 4. Beveled Border Backplate (Signal Accent revealing on interaction)
  const backplateGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width + borderThickness, height + borderThickness);
  const backplateMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: palette.surface,
    roughness: 0.5,
    metalness: 0.5,
    clearcoat: 0.1
  });
  const backplateMesh = new Mesh(backplateGeo, backplateMat);
  backplateMesh.position.z = -0.02;
  cardGroup.add(backplateMesh);

  // Accent Edge Line (Reveals in Red on hover/focus)
  const accentEdgeGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width + borderThickness * 1.5, height + borderThickness * 1.5);
  const accentEdgeMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: palette.accent,
    emissive: palette.accent,
    emissiveIntensity: 0.0,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.0
  });
  const accentEdgeMesh = new Mesh(accentEdgeGeo, accentEdgeMat);
  accentEdgeMesh.position.z = -0.03;
  cardGroup.add(accentEdgeMesh);

  // 5. Main Image Plane
  const imageGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  const imageMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: palette.paper,
    roughness: 0.6,
    metalness: 0.15
  });
  const imageMesh = new Mesh(imageGeo, imageMat);
  cardGroup.add(imageMesh);

  // Safely request asset from texture loader
  const assetUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-mock/home/nodes/cta-hero-isolated.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(assetUrl).then((texture) => {
    imageMat.map = texture;
    imageMat.needsUpdate = true;
  }).catch((err) => {
    // Graceful fallback to flat custom pattern if texture fails to load
    imageMat.color.copy(palette.paper);
  });

  // 6. Caption Strip Frame (Bottom bar)
  const captionHeight = 0.32;
  const captionGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width, captionHeight);
  const captionMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: palette.surface,
    roughness: 0.52,
    metalness: 0.5,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.92
  });
  const captionMesh = new Mesh(captionGeo, captionMat);
  captionMesh.position.set(0, -height / 2 + captionHeight / 2, 0.005);
  cardGroup.add(captionMesh);

  // 7. Light Tuning: Delicate spot and rim local setups
  // Ensures physical attributes of metals and rough finishes are nicely graded
  const keyLight = new SpotLight('#e8ecf2', 1.2, 8, Math.PI / 4, 0.5, 1);
  keyLight.position.set(1.5, 2.5, 1.8);
  container.add(keyLight);

  const fillRimLight = new DirectionalLight('#ff2a38', 0.85); // rim light carries the signal red hue
  fillRimLight.position.set(-2, -1.5, 0.5);
  container.add(fillRimLight);

  // Interaction handlers
  const onPointerOver = () => {
    const tl = trackTimeline(gsap.timeline());
    // Smooth lift & rotation tilt
    tl.to(cardGroup.position, {
      z: 0.15,
      y: 0.06,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: 'power3.out'
    }, 0);
    tl.to(cardGroup.rotation, {
      x: 0.03,
      y: -0.04,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: 'power3.out'
    }, 0);
    // Emissive accent glowing
    tl.to(accentEdgeMat, {
      emissiveIntensity: 1.8,
      opacity: 0.95,
      duration: 0.35,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, 0);
    // Soft shadow adjustment
    tl.to(shadowMesh.position, {
      y: -height / 2 - 0.22,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: 'power3.out'
    }, 0);
    tl.to(shadowMat, {
      opacity: 0.28,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: 'power3.out'
    }, 0);
  };

  const onPointerOut = () => {
    const tl = trackTimeline(gsap.timeline());
    tl.to(cardGroup.position, {
      z: 0,
      y: 0,
      duration: 0.55,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, 0);
    tl.to(cardGroup.rotation, {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      duration: 0.55,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, 0);
    tl.to(accentEdgeMat, {
      emissiveIntensity: 0,
      opacity: 0,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, 0);
    tl.to(shadowMesh.position, {
      y: -height / 2 - 0.15,
      duration: 0.55,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, 0);
    tl.to(shadowMat, {
      opacity: 0.45,
      duration: 0.55,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, 0);
  };

  const onClick = () => {
    ctx.emit('hub-journal.select', { id: config.id });
    
    // Weighted Settle (press-down and rebound action)
    const tl = trackTimeline(gsap.timeline());
    tl.to(cardGroup.scale, {
      x: 0.95,
      y: 0.95,
      z: 0.95,
      duration: 0.12,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    });
    tl.to(cardGroup.scale, {
      x: 1.0,
      y: 1.0,
      z: 1.0,
      duration: 0.65,
      ease: 'back.out(2.2)'
    });
  };

  // Register interactive capabilities and the rigid required cleanup sequence
  container.userData = {
    handlers: {
      pointerover: onPointerOver,
      pointerout: onPointerOut,
      click: onClick
    },
    cleanup: () => {
      // Kill all instantiated GSAP Timelines
      activeTimelines.forEach((tl) => {
        if (tl) tl.kill();
      });
      activeTimelines.length = 0;

      // Unbind and dispose WebGL/WebGPU resource structures
      backdropGeo.dispose();
      backdropMat.dispose();

      shadowGeo.dispose();
      shadowMat.dispose();

      backplateGeo.dispose();
      backplateMat.dispose();

      accentEdgeGeo.dispose();
      accentEdgeMat.dispose();

      imageGeo.dispose();
      imageMat.dispose();

      captionGeo.dispose();
      captionMat.dispose();
    }
  };

  return container;
}
